summary: Issue #408 is fully implemented per the locked tree-preservation design. `_head_preserves_fix_tree` (pre_push_validation.py:544-607) discriminates a non-descendant fix-pass self-commit by tree content via `git merge-tree --write-tree <current_head> <fix_start_head>` compared to `rev-parse <current_head>^{tree}`, defaulting to NOT preserved (rollback) on any non-ok merge, empty/blank output, or rev-parse failure — no bare excepts. The accept decision (lines 831-889) keeps the cheap `_head_descends_from` advance check (#406) first and only runs the tree-preservation merge for the non-descendant rewrite case, logging self_commit_kind advance vs preserving_rewrite. Tests cover preserving-amend accepted+revalidated, work-dropping reset+recommit still rolled back (extends e05b47b6c with a merge-tree assertion), merge-conflict/failed-merge rolled back, parametrized defensive branches of the helper, and the #406 descendant path unchanged (merge-tree not invoked). Scope respected: only the plan doc, pre_push_validation.py, and its test file changed; bootstrap.py, cleanup.py, auth_mounts.py, and remote_repair.py untouched. Working tree clean.
